speaker: Doctor

The latest lab results and initial imaging appear to be normal. Does your shortness of breath improve with rest, and have you noticed any swelling in your ankles or sudden weight gain?

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the normal cardiac and lab results; that helps rule out heart failure and acute infection. Have you noticed a dry cough that worsens at night or when lying flat, and do you ever see frothy or pink-tinged sputum?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, D-Dimer.
REQUEST IMAGES: Echocardiogram.

speaker: Doctor
text:
With your cardiac workup and labs all normal, we can rule out heart failure and acute infection. To narrow this down, have you noticed any heartburn or a sensation of acid rising into your throat, and do you wake up at night coughing?

REQUEST TEST: pH_Metry, Upper_GI_Series.
REQUEST IMAGES: Barium_Swallow.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) with laryngopharyngeal reflux.

The consistent pattern of a dry cough worsening at night or when lying flat, combined with completely normal cardiac, pulmonary, and infectious workups, strongly points to acid reflux irritating your airway. Do you have a history of heartburn, regurgitation, or sour taste in your mouth?
